messages:
Laura Gibbons: Quick heads-up — People Ops approved a 12-week pilot to rotate two contract technical writers across runtime, devex, and docs. Goal: ship clearer runtime how-tos, faster onboarding, and keep runbooks up to date. Will start early next month. :tada:
Priya Natarajan: Love this. Are these contractors or direct hires? and who do they report to day-to-day?
Laura Gibbons: Contractors to start (convert to FTE based on pilot outcomes). Day-to-day reporting will be to Marcus (Docs); dotted to runtime/devex leads for priorities. People Ops will own contracting and onboarding.
Marcus Li: Sounds good — Marcus here. We'll own the hiring funnel and the JD. Scope for the pilot: API reference polish, runtime troubleshooting guides, onboarding playbooks, and runbook maintenance. Prefer overlap PST/EST.
Jordan Kim: Quick Q — will they own runbook updates for incidents or just docs?
Marcus Li: They’ll be the primary owner for runbook doc updates, but incident leadership remains with eng oncall. We want runbooks to be authoritatively owned so ops run faster.
Sahil Patel: Heads-up from eng side — we’ll need a minor perms uplift for contractor GH accounts and CI access. Tagging eng-infra/ops to coordinate.
Hiring Bot: Job req created: REQ-4012 - Contract Technical Writer (Runtime & DevEx focus). Apply: https://hiring.internal/REQ-4012
Laura Gibbons: Action items: 1) Marcus to post JD + one-pager in #recruiting by EOD. 2) Priya/Jordan to send two initial eng partners for each writer (names + repo links). 3) People Ops will queue fast-track onboarding and contract templates. Kickoff scheduled: Wed next week 10:00am PT (calendar invite forthcoming). :calendar:
Priya Natarajan: I’ll DM potential eng partners and sync with Marcus. Excited to get this moving. :rocket:
Marcus Li: Will post JD this afternoon and loop in hiring panel. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
